summary: Add modules/automations (Automations.* and Connections.Manage permissions, settings hub entry, connection store, OAuth2 and SecretResolver wiring, AUTOMATION_PLATFORM_CREDENTIALS) with the /settings/integrations Solid screen, and solid.Bind/solid.NewRPCHandler, a JSON-RPC server for Solid screen methods. The extension runtime now uses a container-provided host.SecretResolver when wiring.Options.Secrets is unset.
